title: Runlet Snippet Library: Lightweight embeddable admin snippets for on-call flows
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: Oncall engineers frequently need small, well-tested operational actions (query metrics, rotate keys, restart worker subsystems) embedded inside incident chat or the Console. Large runbooks are helpful, but we lack a discoverable, safe library of lightweight, parameterized runlets that can be executed as discrete tasks with dry-run and automatic rollbacks.

Goal: Build a Runlet Snippet Library (RSL) and execution harness: a curated catalog of small admin snippets (runlets) with built-in safety guards (confirmations, permission checks, idempotency assertions), a dry-run mode, and minimal UX for running from Console or Slack. Each runlet is packaged as a small manifest + step implementation with telemetry events emitted for audit and cost bookkeeping.

Deliverables:
- RSL catalog UI (Console panel) with tagging, quick search, and example inputs.
- Execution harness service (stateless API + database of runs) supporting dry-run, accept/confirm workflow, and rollback hooks.
- 8 initial runlets (rotate-service-token, clear-kv-prefix, tail-last-logs, bump-replicas-safe, reconcile-cache, db-query-check, refresh-config, embargo-unlock).
- CI validation for runlet idempotency and liveness tests.
- Telemetry + audit events workflow (run.start, run.approve, run.execute, run.rollback, run.finish).

Non-goals: Full runbook authoring experience, interactive multi-step incident playbooks, or exposing root/admin SSH shells via runlets. This is intentionally minimal and permission-gated.
acceptance_criteria: Console page lists > 8 runlets with descriptions, tags, and input schemas
Execution harness supports dry-run that performs no side effects and returns simulated output
All runlets include a pre-check that validates idempotency or aborts with a clear error
Run actions emit the defined telemetry events in tracing/metrics pipeline
A security review is completed and KMS-integrated secrets usage is documented
Manual run flow requires approver when customer_impact == high; otherwise single-approver can execute
Automated CI gate runs liveness and idempotency tests for each authored runlet
Ops and SRE teams sign off on the initial 8 runlets prior to GA rollout
